title: ResultDoc
description: Result v1. Result and error documents go to stdout; stderr carries events and human text only.

arguments_digest.description:
SHA-256 of the normalised arguments (`request_digest` once a request document exists); omitted when no
arguments were given.

blocks.description:
Terrain blocks of a `generate` run: how many were built and how many were kept from the earlier run
because their inputs did not change; omitted when no terrain was generated.

code.description: A stable machine-readable string that callers match on.

contract.description: The contract name, `lodwright-result`: a reader refuses a document that names another.

dropped_faces.description:
Object faces left out by `objects.drop_under_terrain` and `objects.drop_under_water`; omitted when neither
option is on.

inputs_digest.description: SHA-256 over the plugins' sizes and contents; omitted when they were not read.

manifest.description: Relative name of the manifest, when one was written.

missing_capabilities.description: For `unsupported`: the capabilities that are missing.

peak_memory_mib.description: Peak resident memory in MiB; omitted when the platform cannot say.

reason.description: Prose for people; never matched on.

steps.description:
Time, CPU time and peak memory per step of a `generate` run, in the order the steps ran; omitted when the run
did not generate.

tiles.description:
Diffuse tiles of a `generate` run: how many were left to the game's own far-land tiles and how many were
composed; omitted when the run composes every tile (`terrain.compose_shipped_tiles`) or wrote no land tiles.

tool.description: The tool that printed this document.

warning_counts.description:
How many warnings of each kind the run had, sorted by kind; the full list is in `warnings_file`. Omitted
when the run had none.

warnings.description: Things that did not go in and why, at most twenty lines (a missing texture, a model without LOD).

warnings_file.description:
Relative name of the file with every warning, one record each ([`WarningsFile`]), beside the manifest;
omitted when the run had no warning.

up_to_date.description: Blocks whose files were kept from the earlier run.

DroppedFaces.description: Object faces left out, per kind.

under_water.description: Faces wholly under a cell's water (and not under the ground).

oneOf.description: A capability is not built yet; exit code 3.

StepProfile.description: Where a run spent its time and memory: one entry per step, and per world where the step runs once for each.

cpu_ms.description:
CPU time of the whole process during the step in milliseconds, all threads together; omitted where the
platform cannot say. More than `wall_ms` when the step used several threads.

peak_memory_mib.description: Peak resident memory of the process during the step in MiB; omitted where the platform cannot say.

step.description:
The step: `read_plugins`, `terrain`, `objects`, `trees`, `pack` or `manifest` (a finer phase of a step is
named `<step>.<phase>`, for example `objects.models`).

world.description: The world the step ran for; omitted for a step of the whole run.

TileCounts.description: Diffuse tiles left to the game and composed.

composed.description: Tiles composed from the land textures.

kept.description:
Tiles not written because the game ships its own and no plugin outside the game's own masters changed the
land under it.

ToolInfo.description: The tool that produced a document.

WarningCount.description: How many warnings of one kind a run had.

Written.description: What was written for one world and kind.
